answer: Lift the latch on the camera port, slide the ribbon cable straight in, then press the latch down.
title: Fitting the camera cable
intro: I can see a small computer board. Here is how its camera goes on.
summary: Latch up, cable in, latch down.

parts.label: Board
parts.say: This is the board, lying flat.

parts.label: Camera port
parts.say: The camera port is the long thin socket near the edge. Lift its latch gently first.

parts.label: Ribbon cable
parts.say: Slide the ribbon cable straight down into the port, as far as it goes.

parts.label: Camera
parts.say: The camera sits on the other end of the cable.

parts.label: Press the latch
parts.say: Then press the latch back down so the cable stays in.
